fusions.name: Slow Pressure
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy, slow round that deals 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unhurried Finish
fusions.desc: Fires at a target at or below 30% health, dealing 22 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 0.8 times their remaining damage, then leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. The health threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Drifting Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Calm Before
fusions.desc: When your health is full, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
